fields.primary_outcome: acid-base status, pulmonary gas exchange, muscle oxygenation during incremental exercise

fields.primary_outcome: muscle performance, lactate response, and delayed onset muscle soreness
fields.effect_direction_evidence: an acute intermittent HRW hydration improved muscle function, reduced the lactate response, and alleviated delayed onset of muscle soreness.

fields.primary_outcome: peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets (immune function)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: These results show that high-flow hydrogen inhalation has an inhibitory effect on the immune function of healthy participants.

fields.primary_outcome: skin oiliness, moisture, and pH in acne vulgaris patients
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The level of sebum decreased and moisture levels increased during hydrogen purification. Topical hydrogen purification is an effective and safe treatment for acne vulgaris.

fields.primary_outcome: heart rate variability (autonomic cardiac regulation)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: After administration of HRW, we found significantly increased ratio Ln SDNN/RMSSD when comparing it to placebo in 25 min (HRW: 0.40 ± 0.30, placebo: 0.26 ± 0.25, p = .049)

fields.primary_outcome: radiation-induced bone marrow damage (WBC and platelet counts)

fields.primary_outcome: heat-retention effects assessed by thermography post-bathing
tear stability and dry eye symptoms
fields.effect_direction_evidence: H2 significantly and safely improved tear stability and dry eye symptoms in a small exploratory group of 10 human subjects

fields.primary_outcome: angina symptoms and serum lipid levels in unstable angina patients
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Clinical analysis showed hydrogen-rich water intake relieved angina symptoms in unstable angina patients.

fields.primary_outcome: delayed cerebral ischemia and cerebral vasospasm

fields.primary_outcome: UPDRS scores

fields.population_condition: acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD)
fields.primary_outcome: change from baseline in BCSS score at day 7
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Change of BCSS score in Hydrogen/oxygen group was larger than that in Oxygen group (− 5.3 vs. − 2.4 point; difference: − 2.75 [95% CI − 3.27 to − 2.22], meeting criteria for superiority).

fields.primary_outcome: overall survival in lung cancer patients treated with nivolumab
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The 42 patients treated with hydrogen gas and nivolumab (HGN) indicated a significantly longer overall survival (OS) compared with those treated with nivolumab only (n=14).

fields.primary_outcome: fasting blood glucose, fructosamine, 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol, urinary 8-OHdG
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The subjects exhibited significant tendencies for the decreased fasting blood glucose and fructosamine, and for the increased 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol, concomitantly with significant decreases in urinary 8-hydroxy-2-deoxyguanosine contents

fields.primary_outcome: 4.2-km up-hill race time
fields.effect_direction_evidence: HRW for the 4 slowest runners (RT = 1490 [91] s) likely improved the RT (-36 to -3 s), whereas for the 4 fastest runners (RT = 1069 [53] s) the performance effect of HRW was unclear (-10 to 26 s).

fields.primary_outcome: gastritis severity and miRNA expression (miR-7, miR-155, miR-135b, miR-29c)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Endoscopic findings of gastritis were such different (less severe disease), P = 0.024; in 43% diagnosed with moderate gastritis upfront esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) presented mild gastritis after the consumption of alkaline water

fields.primary_outcome: lymphocyte subset immunosenescence indexes
fields.effect_direction_evidence: After 2 weeks of hydrogen therapy, the number of exhausted and senescent cytotoxic T cells decreased to within the normal range, and there was an increase in killer Vδ1 cells.

fields.primary_outcome: diacron-reactive oxygen metabolites (d-ROMs) and biological antioxidant potential
fields.effect_direction_evidence: d-ROMs levels significantly decreased at 8 weeks in ERW compared to those in MW.

fields.primary_outcome: blood total antioxidant capacity (BAP/d-ROMs ratio)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: HW suppressed the reduction in biological antioxidant potential/diacron-reactive oxygen metabolites observed in PW.

fields.primary_outcome: breath acetone levels during submaximal exercise
fields.effect_direction_evidence: H2 significantly augmented breath acetone and enhanced oxygen uptake during exercise (P < 0.01).

fields.primary_outcome: peak oxygen uptake during incremental cycling exercise
fields.effect_direction_evidence: the 2-week continuous consumption of HW significantly augmented peak oxygen uptake and tended to increase the peak load without any significant changes in lactate levels, oxidative stress, and antioxidant responses.

fields.h2_concentration_raw: 7 ppm of H2: 3.5 mg H2 in 500-mL water
fields.primary_outcome: Ln_RHI (reactive hyperemia index via peripheral arterial tonometry)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Ln_RHI improved by 22.2% (p<0.05) at 24 h after the first ingestion of high H2 water and by 25.4% (p<0.05) after the daily consumption of high H2 water for 2 weeks.

fields.primary_outcome: body fluid balance and exercise performance (TTE)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: TTE did not significantly differ between the trials.

fields.primary_outcome: ankle swelling, range of motion, single-leg balance
fields.effect_direction_evidence: HRW was equivalent to RICE protocol to reduce ankle swelling (2.1 ± 0.9% vs. 1.6 ± 0.8%; P = 0.26), range of motion (2.4 ± 1.3 cm vs. 2.7 ± 0.8 cm; P = 0.60)

fields.primary_outcome: pain VAS score at 24-hour follow-up
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The pain VAS self-completed by the patient dropped from 50 points (moderate pain) at baseline (immediately after injury) to 20 points (mild pain) at 24-h follow-up.

fields.population_condition: moderate to severe persistent allergic rhinitis
fields.primary_outcome: nasal nitric oxide (nNO) concentration

fields.primary_outcome: cognitive function (MMSE and ADAS-Cog scores)
skin density change after 4 weeks

fields.primary_outcome: blood cholesterol, glucose, HbA1c, inflammation, redox biomarkers

fields.primary_outcome: progression-free survival and pulmonary symptom prevalence

fields.primary_outcome: LAC, LDH, CPK levels after resistance exercise
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The decrease of LAC and LDH values in the HRW group compared with the placebo were significant. However, the changes of CPK was not significant in neither of the experience.

fields.primary_outcome: running time to exhaustion during incremental treadmill test
fields.effect_direction_evidence: No statistical difference was observed in running time to exhaustion (618 ± 126 vs. 619 ± 113 s)

fields.primary_outcome: objective response rate in cGVHD patients
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Of the 24 patients, 18 (75%; 95% CI, 55.1% to 88%) had an objective response.

fields.primary_outcome: oxidative stress and immune function in peripheral blood cells
oxidative stress markers and cytokines

fields.primary_outcome: dissolved hydrogen concentration and ORP dependencies on water properties
serum creatine kinase and biomarkers of muscular damage at 24h

fields.primary_outcome: airway inflammation markers in peripheral blood and EBC
fields.effect_direction_evidence: A single inhalation of hydrogen for 45 min attenuated inflammatory status in airways in patients with asthma and COPD.

fields.primary_outcome: VAS-estimated alertness in sleep-deprived adults
fields.effect_direction_evidence: no differences were found between interventions (treatment vs. time interaction) for all evaluated outcomes of alertness (P > 0.05), with the effects similar among interventions.

fields.primary_outcome: progression-free survival and overall survival

fields.primary_outcome: skin blotch and visceral fat area changes

fields.primary_outcome: serum Alzheimer's biomarkers (Aβ40, Aβ42, tau), cytokines, ROS, NO

fields.primary_outcome: blood lactate, ventilatory equivalent for O2, RPE during incremental exercise

fields.population_condition: non-small cell lung cancer with multiple metastases

fields.primary_outcome: tumor response (pseudo-progressive remission) after hydrogen inhalation

fields.primary_outcome: tumor size reduction and clinical status in metastatic gallbladder cancer

fields.population_condition: stage III and IV advanced cancer

fields.primary_outcome: radiation-induced bone marrow damage (WBC, PLT, RBC, HGB, HT)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: H2 gas treatment significantly alleviates reducing effects of WBC and PLT respectively.

fields.primary_outcome: urinary 8-OHdG levels
fields.effect_direction_evidence: it did increase urinary 8-OHdG levels by 16%

fields.primary_outcome: reduction rate of corneal endothelial cell density

running time-to-exhaustion in incremental maximal test

fields.primary_outcome: liver fat accumulation measured by dual-echo MRI

fields.primary_outcome: submaximal exercise HR and RR during graded treadmill test
fields.effect_direction_evidence: HRW significantly decreased average exercising RR and HR (p < 0.05).

fields.primary_outcome: psychometric fatigue (VAS) and endurance (VO2max)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Endurance and fatigue were significantly improved in the H2 group as judged by maximal oxygen consumption and Borg's scale, respectively.

fields.primary_outcome: peak expiratory flow rate
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The combination of alkaline water and asthma-induced gymnastics effectively and significantly improves the peak expiratory flow rate values at the Day 8 (p = 0.039) and the Day 14 (p = 0.012).

fields.primary_outcome: antioxidant activity and gut flora diversity in soccer players
fields.effect_direction_evidence: the consumption of hydrogen-rich water for two months significantly reduced serum malondialdehyde, interleukin-1, interleukin-6, tumour necrosis factor-α levels; then significantly increased serum superoxide dismutase, total antioxidant capacity levels and haemoglobin levels

fields.primary_outcome: gastrointestinal symptoms and general health
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Sufficiently clear effect could not be confirmed. But the stools were more normal, and, as shown in the previous report, that drinking AEW is considered to contribute to intestinal normalization.

fields.population_condition: pemphigus vulgaris with infected skin ulcers
fields.primary_outcome: treatment of skin ulcers infected with conditional pathogenic strains
fields.effect_direction_evidence: We are the first to report on a new, safe, and effective treatment of infections induced by conditional pathogenic strains with local wet packing with hydrogen water.

fields.primary_outcome: proportion of terminal PD-1+ CD8+ T cells and survival outcomes
fields.effect_direction_evidence: 14 patients treated with a combined therapy of hydrogen gas and nivolumab showed a significantly longer OS than the remaining 12 patients who were treated with nivolumab alone.

fields.primary_outcome: acid-base balance, hydration status, and anaerobic capacity
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The results indicate that drinking alkalized water enhances hydration, improves acid-base balance and anaerobic exercise performance.

fields.primary_outcome: peak power output during repeated sprints
oxidative/nitrosative stress markers and GERD symptom scores
fields.effect_direction_evidence: combination treatment with PPI and ERW improves the cellular redox state leading to the improvement of the quality of life as demonstrated by the correlation analysis between laboratory parameters and GERD symptoms.

fields.primary_outcome: symptoms and signs score, treatment index, total effective rate
fields.effect_direction_evidence: There were significant differences of the symptoms, signs scores, the treatment index, the total efficiency and BQLQ between the two kinds of lavage fluid used for patients before and after treatment(P<0.05).

fields.primary_outcome: muscle soreness (VAS), neutrophil dynamics, muscle damage markers

fields.effect_direction_evidence: H2 treatment significantly reduced body fat percentage (3.2 vs. 0.9%, P = 0.05) and arm fat index (9.7 vs. 6.0%, P = 0.01) compared to placebo administration, respectively.

fields.primary_outcome: anaerobic performance and acid-base balance
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The results of the specific anaerobic endurance test revealed a significant difference in performance between the tests performed after hydrating with highly alkaline water in comparison to table water.

fields.primary_outcome: mood, anxiety, autonomic nerve function (K6 score, sympathetic activity)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Change ratios (post-treatment/pre-treatment) for K6 score and sympathetic nerve activity during the resting state were significantly lower after HRW administration than after PLW administration.

fields.primary_outcome: composite of all-cause mortality and non-lethal cardio-cerebrovascular events
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Multivariate analysis of the Cox proportional hazards model revealed E-HD as an independent significant factor for the primary endpoint (hazard ratio 0.59; [95% confidence interval: 0.38-0.92])

fields.primary_outcome: peritoneal membrane preservation (mesothelial cells, thickness)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Histological study revealed a significant increase in the number of mesothelial cells and a significant decrease in peritoneal thickness in the H2-PD group as compared to the control and PD groups.

fields.primary_outcome: ADAS-cog score after 1 year
fields.effect_direction_evidence: although there was no significant difference between the H2- and control groups in ADAS-cog score after 1 year, carriers of the apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) genotype in the H2-group were improved significantly on total ADAS-cog score

fields.primary_outcome: IBS symptom improvement rate over 8 weeks
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Eight patients (61.5%) in the ARW group and six patients (42.9%) in the control group indicated that their symptoms had improved in more than four out of the eight weeks of treatment (p = 0.449).

fields.primary_outcome: 8-oxo-dG and MDA levels after exercise-induced oxidative stress
fields.effect_direction_evidence: In the test group, its levels at each time were significantly lower than that in the peak level.

fields.primary_outcome: keratin plug cleansing and capillary blood stream in healthy subjects
fields.effect_direction_evidence: After hydrogen warm water bathing, the numbers of cleansed keratin plugs also increased on cheek of subjects 2.30- to 4.47-fold as many as the control for normal warm water.

fields.primary_outcome: Change in total UPDRS score from baseline to 72nd week
inspiratory effort via diaphragm electromyography (EMGdi)
PASI score improvement at week 8
fields.effect_direction_evidence: 24.4% of patients (10/41) receiving hydrogen-water bathing achieved at least 75% improvement in Psoriasis Area Severity Index (PASI) score compared with 2.9% of patients (1/34) of the control group (Pc = 0.022)

fields.primary_outcome: cardiac salvage index at 7 days after primary PCI
fields.effect_direction_evidence: the cardiac salvage index as evaluated using cardiac magnetic resonance imaging at 7 days after primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), showed no significant between-group difference (HI: 50.0±24.3%; control: 60.1±20.1%; P=0.43)

fields.primary_outcome: streptococcal biofilm formation inhibition
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Our data showed that H-water caused a significant decrease in in vitro streptococcal biofilm formation.

fields.primary_outcome: blood condition / redox potential effects on human blood
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The powerful antioxidant effect of hydrogen-saturated water is indicated. Blood state close to ideal is observed after consumption of natural mineral medical-table hydrogen-saturated water «Polyana Kvasova».

fields.primary_outcome: breath H2 concentration after consumption of H2-producing milk
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The total range of H2 production (area under the curve) increased and a higher peak concentration was observed compared with consumption of H2 water or pure cows' milk.

fields.primary_outcome: clinical profiles incl. anti-hypertensive use, fatigue, pruritus
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Multivariate analysis revealed E-HD was an independent significant factor for the reduced use of anti-hypertensive agents as well as the absence of severe fatigue and pruritus at 12 months after adjusting for confounding factors.

fields.primary_outcome: MRI signal intensity, NIHSS scores, Barthel Index
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The following significant effects were found: the relative signal intensity of MRI, which indicated the severity of the infarction site, NIHSS scores for clinically quantifying stroke severity, and physical therapy evaluation, as judged by the Barthel Index.

fields.primary_outcome: random blood sugar levels
fields.effect_direction_evidence: there is a significant difference in the level of random blood sugar of diabetes mellitus type 2 performed by using four kinds of intervention of alkaline water treatment

fields.primary_outcome: serum superoxide anions, SOD activity, total antioxidant capacity
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The serum superoxide anions, serum SOD activities, and total antioxidant capacities of athletes during and after training were significantly superior to those of the control group (P<0.05)

fields.primary_outcome: serum antioxidant enzymes (SOD, glutathione, catalase, GPx) and MDA
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Hydrogen-rich water intervention significantly improved serum activities of superoxide dismutase and glutathione as compared to the placebo (P < 0.05), while no differences were observed between groups for changes in catalase and glutathione peroxidase

fields.primary_outcome: liver function (ALT, AST, ALP, IBIL, direct bilirubin) after mFOLFOX6
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The hydrogen-rich water group exhibited no significant differences in liver function before and after treatment, whereas the placebo group exhibited significantly elevated levels of ALT, AST and IBIL.

fields.primary_outcome: post-exercise blood pH and lactates
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Hydrogen-rich water significantly affected post-exercise blood pH and lactates as compared to the placebo (P < 0.05)

fields.primary_outcome: FeNO, lung function, inflammatory and oxidative stress markers
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Inhalation of hydrogen gas could alleviate airway inflammation and oxidative stress of sanitation workers exposed to air pollution.

fields.primary_outcome: ROS in blood (FORT test)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: ROS was showed lower tendency in HW group than PW group after drinking, and especially lowest tendency in a minute (p<0.01) and 5 minutes (p<0.05).

fields.primary_outcome: exercise-induced oxidative stress and delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Weekly hydrogen bathing had no effects of exercise-induced oxidative stress and muscle damage. On the other hand, hydrogen bathing significantly reduced DOMS (VAS) 1 and 2days after downhill running (p=0.033).

fields.primary_outcome: fraction of human mercaptalbumin (f(HMA)) pre- and post-HD
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The f(HMA) of EWHD2015 significantly increased from EWHD2014 on both pre- and post-HD (pre, 51.32 ± 5.63 % → 58.03 ± 7.43 %; post, 72.04 ± 5.73 % → 76.42 ± 4.67 %).

fields.primary_outcome: treatment response in chronic graft-versus-host-disease
fields.effect_direction_evidence: we report a patient with severe chronic graft-versus-host-disease successfully treated by drinking hydrogen rich water which may be a safe and effective method for chronic graft-versus-host-disease.

fields.primary_outcome: feasibility and safety of hydrogen gas inhalation in PCAS patients
fields.effect_direction_evidence: No undesirable effects attributable to HI were observed and 4 patients survived 90 days with a favorable neurological outcome.

fields.primary_outcome: blood viscosity at high and low shear rates after exercise-induced dehydration
fields.effect_direction_evidence: consumption of the electrolyzed, high-pH water reduced high-shear viscosity by an average of 6.30% compared to 3.36% with standard purified water (p = 0.03).

fields.primary_outcome: serum NSE, IL-6, and TNF-α levels
fields.effect_direction_evidence: After treatment, these levels in the hydrogen water group were lower than those in the conventional group.

probing pocket depth and clinical attachment level
DAS28 and PASI score changes during H2 treatment

fields.primary_outcome: peripheral blood IL-1β mRNA expression after acarbose
fields.effect_direction_evidence: The induction of hydrogen gas production and the reduction in peripheral blood IL-1β mRNA after the test meal were not significant between days 1 (without acarbose) and 2 (with acarbose).

fields.primary_outcome: DAS28 disease activity score in 28 joints
fields.effect_direction_evidence: In the H2-infused group, average DAS28 decreased from 5.18 ± 1.16 to 4.02 ± 1.25 immediately post infusion and reached 3.74 ± 1.22 after 4 weeks.

fields.primary_outcome: arterial blood pH at baseline and post-exercise

fields.primary_outcome: plasma viscosity and limb swelling after musculotendinous injury
fields.effect_direction_evidence: HYD intervention augmented the decrease in plasma viscosity as compared to the CON (20.7 ± 2.4 vs. 15.4 ± 1.9%; p = 0.002).

fields.primary_outcome: biochemical markers of inflammation and functional recovery
fields.effect_direction_evidence: oral and topical hydrogen intervention resulted in a faster return to normal joint range of motion for both flexion and extension of the injured limb as compared with the control intervention (P < 0.05)

fields.primary_outcome: albumin redox state as marker of oxidative stress

fields.primary_outcome: wound healing / pressure ulcer recovery in hospitalized elderly patients
fields.effect_direction_evidence: PU hospitalized days in EG were significantly shorter than in LG (113.3 days vs. 155.4 days, p < 0.05), and the shortening rate was approximately 28.1%.

fields.primary_outcome: patient-reported symptoms (ICSI, ICPI, PUF, VAS pain, voiding diary)
fields.effect_direction_evidence: the effect of hydrogen-rich water on symptoms was not significantly different from that of placebo

fields.primary_outcome: safety/complications of IV H2-enriched solution in acute ischemic stroke
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Data from the current study indicate that an H2-enriched intravenous solution is safe for patients with acute cerebral infarction, including patients treated with t-PA.

fields.primary_outcome: serum LDL-cholesterol levels and HDL function
fields.effect_direction_evidence: consumption of H2-rich water for 10 weeks resulted in decreased serum total-cholesterol (TC) and low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol (LDL-C) levels.

fields.primary_outcome: albumin redox state (reduced albumin fraction) in effluent and blood
fields.effect_direction_evidence: Mean proportion of reduced albumin (ƒ(HMA)) in effluent was significantly higher in H2-enriched dialysate (62.31 ± 11.10%) than in standard dialysate (54.70 ± 13.08%).

fields.primary_outcome: oxidative stress markers in serum

fields.primary_outcome: wrinkle formation and skin damage under UVA irradiation

fields.primary_outcome: blood hydrogen concentration and physiological safety parameters

fields.primary_outcome: quality of life (QLQ-C30 global health status) during radiotherapy

fields.primary_outcome: inflammatory markers and blood pressure control in haemodialysis patients
